question: Which of the following shortcut key is used to open a new file in MS-Word 365?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + N**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ctrl + N -- Open a new/blank document.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Word shortcut keys

 
• Ctrl + A -- Select all contents of the page.
 
• Ctrl + B -- Bold highlighted selection.
 
• Ctrl + C -- Copy selected text.
 
• Ctrl + X -- Cut selected text.
 
• Ctrl + N -- Open new/blank document.
 
• Ctrl + O -- Open options.
 
• Ctrl + P -- Open the print window.
